sections.name: THEME_COLOR
sections.title: Fixed browser colours for light and dark
sections.what: Stores the light background colour and the dark background colour as fixed codes. These are used where the browser cannot read the site's colour variables.
sections.why: The comment states that the browser needs literal colours.
sections.watch_out: Keep these values in step with the stylesheet tokens, or the browser colour drifts from the page.

summary: Holds the fixed light and dark background colour codes that the browser needs for its own colour bar.
purpose: Lets the browser toolbar and theme colour match the site's background in each mode.
why: The comment says browser chrome needs literal colours that it cannot read from the stylesheet.
how: Declares one object with a light colour code and a dark colour code, marked as fixed values.
outputs: The THEME_COLOR object with light and dark colour codes.
risks: If the stylesheet colours change and this file does not, the browser colour will not match the page.
debug: If the browser colour looks wrong, compare these values with the theme tokens stylesheet. The comment names a test that should catch mismatches.
